review.summary: All five original-resolution captures are coherent Workbench renders of the expected Everon-derived scene. The pose and look-at captures are visibly distinct from their preceding current views, and both following current captures return to the initial composition without visible corruption or contamination.

captures.label: initial-current
captures.observation: Coherent ground-level editor view of the expected rural and industrial terrain; no blank frame, decode artifact, or foreign-window contamination is visible.

captures.label: explicit-pose
captures.observation: Coherent elevated forest-and-field view that is materially distinct from the initial current view.

captures.label: post-pose-restoration-current
captures.observation: Returns to the same ground-level composition as the initial current capture, consistent with successful camera restoration.

captures.label: explicit-look-at
captures.observation: Coherent elevated oblique view centered toward the industrial compound; materially distinct from the preceding restored current view.

captures.label: post-look-at-restoration-current

warnings: Expected Workbench editor overlays are visible, including the orientation widget, axis indicator, and world-region labels; some labels are cropped at frame edges. These do not obscure the camera-path evidence but the captures are not presentation screenshots.
limitations: The review establishes render integrity, visible view displacement, and visible restoration consistency; it does not make a gameplay or editorial-content claim.
The finalized manifest was unmodified at review and remains Unreviewed with imagesReviewed=false. This separate record supplies the formal image review and is bound to that export by SHA-256.
This is one controlled Workbench 1.7.0.54 run on one machine; minimized, out-of-focus, headless, world-unload, agent-loss, and remote/delegated behavior are outside its scope.
